title: PatchSetPreviewResponse
description: Response body of POST /api/patch-sets/preview (HEL-408). One EditPreview per edit, in the caller's given order. The preview computes each edit's before/after state and impact hints PURELY IN MEMORY -- no resource named in the patch set is ever mutated by this call. See EditPreview's own description for the before/after/impact contract (design.md D2/D3/D4).

EditPreview.description: before/after reuse each target kind's EXISTING response shape (PanelResponse/DashboardResponse/DataSourceResponse/PipelineSummaryResponse/PipelineStepResponse) -- deliberately left as a generic object here rather than a five-way oneOf, since the concrete shape is determined by the edit's target.kind, not expressible as a single $ref (mirrors patch-set-apply-response.schema.json's identical EditOutcome convention). HEL-904 removed the `dataType` target kind outright (DataType/DataTypeResponse no longer exist); an `output` target kind is P1.4's (HEL-907) job to add.

index.description: The edit's position in the original patch set's edits array.

before.description: The resource's full pre-edit state, serialized using its target kind's existing response shape. Absent for create edits.

after.description: The resource's projected post-edit state, computed purely in memory (no write). Absent for delete edits. A create edit's `after.id` carries the literal sentinel string "(pending)", never a real minted id.

impact.description: Cascade/staleness hints a user should know about before accepting this edit (design.md D4). Empty when the edit has no such consequence.
